title: Rectangular prism
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees in all axes and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on the first face. This sketch consists of a single closed loop made up of ten lines. Begin the first line at coordinates (0.0, 0.057) and end it at (0.0, 0.0612). Continue with the second line from (0.0, 0.0612) to (0.075, 0.0612), the third line from (0.075, 0.0612) to (0.0792, 0.0612), the fourth line from (0.0792, 0.0612) to (0.0792, 0.06), the fifth line from (0.0792, 0.06) to (0.0792, 0.0529), the sixth line from (0.0792, 0.0529) to (0.0792, 0.0), the seventh line from (0.0792, 0.0) to (0.075, 0.0), the eighth line from (0.075, 0.0) to (0.075, 0.0529), the ninth line from (0.075, 0.0529) to (0.075, 0.057), and finally, the tenth line from (0.075, 0.057) back to (0.0, 0.057). After completing the sketch, apply a scaling factor of 0.0792 to the entire sketch. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three-dimensional space using the same Euler angles and translation vector used initially. Extrude the two-dimensional sketch to create a three-dimensional model, setting the extrusion depth towards the normal to 0.75 and the extrusion depth opposite the normal to 0.0. Finally, integrate the current part by creating a new solid body from the extruded sketch. The final dimensions of the rectangular prism with rounded edges and a flat top are a length of 0.07916666666666669, a width of 0.06121475, and a height of 0.75.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch points
points = [
    (0.0, 0.057),
    (0.0, 0.0612),
    (0.075, 0.0612),
    (0.0792, 0.0612),
    (0.0792, 0.06),
    (0.0792, 0.0529),
    (0.0792, 0.0),
    (0.075, 0.0),
    (0.075, 0.0529),
    (0.075, 0.057),
    (0.0, 0.057)
]

# Create the sketch
r = r.polyline(points).close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.75)

# The final model is represented as 'r'

import cadquery as cq

# L-shaped angle profile extruded vertically
t = 0.008  # wall thickness
Lx = 0.0792  # leg along X
Ly = 0.0612  # leg along Y

r = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(0, 0)
    .lineTo(Lx, 0)
    .lineTo(Lx, t)
    .lineTo(t, t)
    .lineTo(t, Ly)
    .lineTo(0, Ly)
    .close()
    .extrude(0.75)
)

import cadquery as cq

# L-shaped angle profile extruded along Z
# Bounding box: X 0.0792, Y 0.0612, Z 0.7500
# Wall thickness of the angle legs
t = 0.012

Lx = 0.0792  # overall width in X
Ly = 0.0612  # overall depth in Y
Lz = 0.7500  # length in Z

# Sketch the L profile on the XY plane
profile = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(0, 0)
    .lineTo(Lx, 0)
    .lineTo(Lx, t)
    .lineTo(t, t)
    .lineTo(t, Ly)
    .lineTo(0, Ly)
    .close()
)

# Extrude the profile to full length
r = profile.extrude(Lz)
